title: Private Pool in East Nashville
description:
Incredible outdoor living space complete with heated cocktail pool, fireplace, television and games. Perfect place to relax and wind down after a busy day in the city or before getting ready to hit the town at night. This guest suite located within walking distance of 5 points in East Nashville. It has its own entrance, walk in closet, kitchenette, spacious bathroom, outdoor living room and a pool. It is centrally located to many restaurants, bars and shops. 2 miles from downtown.

The space
This is a guest suite on the bottom level of our home. It has its own entrance and living space not shared with the rest of the home. It has a walk in closet, full bathroom with shower, kitchenette with mini fridge, ice maker and microwave. The bedroom has a queen size bed with television. Outdoor living room has sofa, chairs, television and fireplace. Pool area has loungers and chairs.

Guest access
Patio with fireplace and tv, cocktail pool, guest quarters with kitchenette, walk in closet and large bathroom

During your stay
You can communicate with us directly via phone and texting
